name: Flatland Cougar Femur
summary: Across Mulgore, cougars prowl the plains, and Maur Raincaller needs one of their bones. A Flatland Cougar Femur is part of the remedy he seeks for a venomous bite.

sections.title: A Remedy for a Venomous Bite
sections.body: Flatland cougars rank among Mulgore's most dangerous native stalkers. They blend into the dry brush, then spring upon unsuspecting prey. Hunters take their pelts and claws for leatherworking and trophies, while their heavy, marrow-rich bones have use in local medicine. Maur Raincaller of Bloodhoof Village suffered a venomous wound from Mazzranache, a monstrous pink strider. He urgently asked for a cougar femur and parts from other local beasts. Crushed or boiled, the bone yields properties for an antitoxin poultice meant to draw fever and necrotic venom from a festering bite.

faq.q: What is the Flatland Cougar Femur used for?
faq.answer: Maur Raincaller in Bloodhoof Village needs the femur to make an emergency remedy. The notorious plainstrider Mazzranache bit him, and he needs the marrow and bone to prepare an antitoxin before its virulent venom kills him.

faq.q: Where do you obtain a Flatland Cougar Femur?
faq.answer: You can gather a Flatland Cougar Femur from flatland cougars roaming Mulgore's central and southern plains. They prowl near the hillsides and through the tall grasses around Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: Why would Maur Raincaller need a cougar bone specifically?
faq.answer: Tauren herbalists and shamans use the dense bones and marrow of predatory animals in traditional salves and tinctures. They believe the strength and resilience of Mulgore's apex predators provide the restorative foundation needed to neutralize potent toxins.

Maur Raincaller lives in Bloodhoof Village. After wandering the plains, he ran afoul of Mazzranache, a legendary strider his grandfather once fought, and barely escaped with an infected, venomous bite to the shoulder.

angles.text: For the tauren of Mulgore, hunting flatland cougars tests vigilance and provides vital materials for traditional plains remedies.
As a hunter, you need sharp eyes to track flatland cougars through Mulgore's swaying brush, and the hunt tests your skill at bringing down a fellow predator cleanly.
